name: Mark Rutte
quote: I affirmed that NATO stands ready to defend every inch of Allied territory. We will continue to enhance our readiness to deter and defend against any threat, including from drones.

name: Donald Tusk
quote: I am in contact with NATO command and other European leaders regarding the violation of Polish airspace. Everyone declares full solidarity and readiness for any assistance.

name: Nicușor Dan
quote: It is inadmissible and intolerable for the Russian Federation to continue violating Romania's airspace, which is, at the same time, NATO airspace and European Union airspace.

name: Dmitry Peskov
quote: There are absolutely no grounds to blame Russia for this. Western European officials should broaden their horizons when it comes to drone sightings.

name: Evika Siliņa
role: Former Prime Minister of Latvia (resigned May 2026)
quote: I am resigning, but I am not giving up.

name: Gitanas Nausėda
quote: Lithuania will not allow any foreign power involved in the conflict in Europe to use its territory or airspace to launch drone strikes against another state.

name: Margus Tsahkna
quote: A concrete consequence of Russia's full-scale war of aggression.

name: Kristen Michal
quote: Our aid to Ukraine cannot be delayed at the most crucial moment. No pressure on Russia means no peace.

name: Ursula von der Leyen
quote: This is a deliberate strategy from Russia trying to destabilise our democratic societies. When Baltic states are being tested, Europe as a whole is being tested.

name: Alexander Dobrindt
role: Federal Minister of the Interior, Germany
quote: The attack was carried out by professionals, probably on behalf of foreign powers, as part of a hybrid war scenario.

name: Andrii Sybiha
quote: Ukraine formally apologized to Finland, Latvia, and Estonia for the drones that entered their airspace, and committed Ukrainian technical experts to help build preventative measures.

name: Dorothee Bär
quote: Unwanted drones over an airport? Over a stadium? Not with us!

name: Col. Martin O'Donnell
quote: NATO is a defensive Alliance and Allies are constantly honing their defensive abilities.

name: Radu Miruță
quote: The drone was carrying explosives. Ukraine has confirmed it did not belong to its forces.

name: Laurențiu Diaconu
quote: The area was isolated, and residents within the safety perimeter of approximately 300 meters were evacuated.

name: Friedrich Merz
quote: Those behind hybrid attacks against Germany will pay for them.
